criteria.no: The item does not state the directive: it is silent about it, names only the topic, or describes a different approach.
criteria.unclear: The item states part of the directive's content but it cannot be determined whether it plans the directive itself.
criteria.yes: The item says atm-bd reads bd ready first and then checks the ATM tasks for that bead id, assigning only when none exists.

addressed.instructions: `anchor.statement` requires that atm-bd assigns a sanity or qa bead only when bd ready lists it and, checked after that, no ATM task with that bead id exists, so a bead whose task the hook already assigned is never assigned twice. Does `item.text` state this directive's specific content as a step, constraint or decision? An item that only names the topic, or that checks in another order, uses an earlier or cached task list, or skips the task check, does not state it. Judge presence of the directive only, not whether the item conflicts with it.

criteria.no: Nothing in the item is one of the ruled-out cases, including when the item is silent about the directive.
criteria.unclear: The item is ambiguous enough that it might describe one of the ruled-out cases, but it cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: The item states a plan, approach or decision that is one of the ruled-out cases.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` plan something that `anchor.statement` rules out? The anchor rules out: checking ATM tasks before reading bd ready, or using a task list read earlier in the tick or in a previous tick; assigning a ready sanity or qa bead without checking for an existing ATM task; assigning a bead a second time. These are not a conflict: silence about the filter order; building vars or templates for the assignment. Judge conflict only.

criteria.no: The item is about a different part of the system or a different activity and does not touch how atm-bd decides whether to assign a sanity or qa bead: reading bd ready and checking for an existing ATM task.
criteria.unclear: The item text is too vague to tell whether it touches the anchor's subject.
criteria.yes: The item plans or changes how atm-bd picks, filters or assigns sanity or qa beads.

relevant.instructions: The state holds one planning item (`item.title`, `item.text`) and one anchor (`anchor.statement`, `anchor.scope`) about how atm-bd decides whether to assign a sanity or qa bead: reading bd ready and checking for an existing ATM task. Does the work described in `item.text` plan, change, or depend on that subject? Judge overlap of subject matter only. Do not judge whether the item obeys the anchor.

anchor.statement: atm-bd must assign a sanity or qa bead only when bd ready lists it and, checked afterwards, no ATM task with that bead id exists; a bead whose task the hook already assigned is never assigned a second time.
anchor.scope: atm-bd dispatch candidate filter order for sanity and qa beads

item.text: For each sanity or qa bead in the bd ready output, dispatch then queries atm task list for a task carrying that bead id and assigns the bead only if no such task exists.
